title: PSSSB Notification 2026 - Apply Online for 27 Junior Engineer Posts
description: Punjab Subordinate Service Selection Board (PSSSB) has declared the official notification for 2026. To fill the vacancies for 27 Junior Engineer Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in B.E/ B.Tech in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or Electrical Engineering can use this opportunity and apply for the PSSSB Notification 2026 .
